slides.headline: How to get paid to hold a stock, in [3 numbers]

slides.title: 1. The yield: cash per $100
paras: Yearly dividend divided by price. Pepsi: $5.92 a share, $140.54 price = <g>4.2%</g>.

slides.title: 2. What $10,000 pays you a year
slides.text: Same money, [13x] more cash from Pepsi than Apple.

slides.title: 3. The raises: is it growing?
paras: Coca-Cola raised its dividend <g>64 years in a row</g>. A cut is the red flag. Past data, not a promise.
